title: Chapter 58: First Encounter
content:
Chapter 58: First Encounter

Going to greet the visiting lord, Wu Qing was accompanied by ten insect men, eight one-star hydralisks and a small group of puppies to boost his momentum.

Meng was followed by a group of tiger cavalry.

The other armies of the Tiger Leader and the incoming Zerg troops were all distributed throughout the city in a war-ready state, demonstrating the military strength of the alliance between the two sides.

Such preparations are also necessary. It is still unknown what actions the bugbears and tengu clan will take.

Meng took Wu Qing to the main gate of the city. The tiger cavalry on guard outside would bring all the visiting lords here, and they would greet them personally.

It was still early at this time, and some of the smaller territories that were closer had already arrived.

The lords of these small territories come from all races, and they only bring some personal guards to ensure basic safety.

Wu Qing got to know these lords under Meng's introduction.

These lords were very polite to Meng and Wu Qing. The two sides were polite and did not communicate much. Meng sent people to take them to the city for temporary resettlement.

The first heavyweight lord to come was the fox lord of Hujiaqiu. He was an old man from the fox clan with white beard and hair. He was a little thin and rode a giant red fox.

In this world, it seems that different races find it easy to subdue the mounts of closely related races.

Like the fierce tigers of the Tiger Clan, the giant foxes of the Fox Clan are actually members of the Tengu Clan, and they ride relatively common lizard mounts.

Behind the lord of the Fox Tribe, followed a team of escorts composed entirely of Fox Tribe cavalry. The mounts of the cavalry were all red giant foxes.

"Haha, welcome Lord Hujiaqiu! Thank you for coming to support us!"

Seeing the Fox Clan's team, Meng's trademark laugh came.

"The Lord of the Tiger Territory has invited me, so I have to come!"

The fox lord got off his mount with a smile.

"This is Lord Hu Wei from the Hujiaqiu Territory! This is Lord Wu Qing from the Daxia Territory!"

Meng introduced the two of them.

"Nice to meet you!"

Wu Qing smiled.

"Lord Daxia? These past few days have been full of news about the battle between you and the army of followers of the evil god! Please pay me your respects, little old man!"

After hearing the fierce introduction, Hu Wei looked solemn and was about to bow to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing saw it, stepped forward to support him, and said: "No way! The battle between us and the army of evil believers is a grudge between the two camps, and it is also for self-protection. We should not deserve this gift!"

Meng looked on with a smile. With Wu Qing's support, Hu Wei gave up and put a smile on his face again.

"In any case, Daxia leader took the initiative to fight at this critical moment, which can be regarded as protecting the peace of our side. When everyone is here, I will thank you again!"

"Haha, no need to be polite anymore. When today's matters are finished, we can talk about thank you or not!"

"There are many guests here today, we will talk about it later!"

"Okay, let's go take a rest first and see you later!"

"goodbye!"

"Come here! Send the lord to take a rest first!"

Meng saw that another lord was coming, so he called someone to arrange for Hu Wei and his party to rest.

In a short period of time, Meng and Wu Qing welcomed no less than 30 lords.

…

The lord of Blackstone Castle, the lord of Wutong Village and the former lord of White Wolf arrived one after another and introduced Wu Qing one by one.

The lord of Blackstone Castle is a dark-faced middle-aged uncle with a tall figure and muscles as strong as rock. His name is Shi Gan. Compared with the human race, the skin of the stone race can see some obvious differences.

Shi Gan and the Stone Clan's guard team all came on foot. The Stone Clan guards were all covered in heavy metal armor, holding shields and swords, and also carried throwable hand axes.

This is a well-equipped elite heavy infantry unit that is incredibly powerful on the battlefield.

…

The Lord of Wutong Village looks like a handsome young man named Yu Chong [chōng]. He is dressed in white and has a slender figure. He has an elegant temperament, a gentle smile, and is very approachable.

He rode a snow-white and powerful unicorn horse and carried an exaggeratedly large bow.

Behind him was a team of elite archers from the Feather Clan riding white unicorn horses.

…

The last one to arrive was the former lord of the White Wolf named Bai Yan. The white wolf had a pair of cold eyes on his head and several ferocious scars on his face.

His temperament is exactly the opposite of Yu Chong, the lord of Wudong Village, which makes him feel difficult to get along with.

The wolves are all wolf cavalry, equipped with weapons such as broadswords and throwing spears.

…

Most of the elite military units in this world are equipped with both long and near weapons, which can be used for long-distance and close combat, and can adapt well to complex battlefield environments.

The three lords have different images and personalities, but they all respect Meng very much and are very polite to Wu Qing.

These lords are not the underage lords of the Tengu clan. They are impeccable in their treatment of others and are not simple people.

Just after early morning, almost all the lords who had been waiting for Meng had arrived. There were still some who had not arrived due to various reasons, so he and Wu Qing no longer welcomed them in person.

In the Mansion of Lord Tiger Lord, many tables and chairs were placed in the open-air square where Wu Qing was received. The tables were filled with various kinds of food, and several kinds of meat were roasting on the bonfire burning in the square.

The reception is very down-to-earth, and the first thing is to eat.

Under Meng's personal guidance, all the lords entered the square, followed the signs on the table, and took their seats.

Meng and Wu Qing sat at the same table. The seats of the lords were arranged without obvious distinction of priority, which prevented the small lords from having some small emotions.

After everyone was seated, Meng stood up and said loudly: "I had no choice but to invite you all here so early!"

"Many people probably haven't had breakfast yet, so let's eat first!"

"I like to talk about things while eating, it feels good to talk like this, haha!"

"Come on! Eat first!"

Meng sat down, grabbed a large piece of meat on the table, and started eating.

The lords present should have a certain understanding of Meng, and they didn't feel strange. They all picked up their favorite food and started eating.

After eating for a while, Meng asked the people responsible for adding food to go out, and only the lords were left in the huge square.

He wiped his hands fiercely, stood up again, and said: "Everyone should have eaten enough. Those who are not full can continue to eat!"

"I will say a few words here first!"

"Everyone should be clear about the current situation. I know that the territories of many lords present here are stronger than they show, and they are not afraid of the small cleanup troops of the evil god believers' army."

"I think everyone should be betting! Betting that the Tengu tribe can win this war!"

"As long as the Tengu tribe wins this war and regains control of this area, our territories can continue to survive because they are in the same camp!"

"To be honest, I personally don't think highly of the Tengu tribe. My Tiger Territory is ready for a decisive battle!"

"But what I didn't expect was that God gave us another chance! The Great Xia Territory and the Zerg appeared!"
